content:
For \(e=6\), all \(\binom{5}{2}=10\) distinct odd pairs qualify.  
For \(e=8\), likewise all \(\binom{5}{2}=10\) distinct odd pairs qualify.

Thus the exactly two-odd case has
\[
6+8+9+10+10=43
\]
valid selections.

The all-even case contributes \(8\) valid selections.

Total:
\[
43+8=51
\]

\[
\boxed{51}
\]
